blocks.text: Allaah's Name Al-Waasi' The Vast One is repeated in many places of the Qur'aan.
It means vast in Attributes and descriptions and what is connected to them in terms of no one being able to praise Him as He deserves; indeed He is as He praised Himself.
He is vast in might, authority and kingship. He is vast in grace and perfection, mighty in generosity and honour.
Allaah said in clarifying His vast knowledge and mercy:
Our Lord! You comprehend all things in mercy and knowledge,
Allaah said in clarifying His vast provision:
If they be poor, Allah will enrich them out of His Bounty. And Allah is All-Sufficient for His creatures' needs, All-Knowing
Allaah said in clarifying His vast forgiveness:
Allah promises you Forgiveness from Himself and Bounty, and Allah is All-Sufficient for His creatures' needs, All-Knower.
From the evidences of His Name Al-Waasi' is that He has made ease for the servants in their religion so He does not burden them with more than they can bear.
Allah burdens not a person beyond his scope.
All praises are due to Allaah for what He has given and made easy - pure, blessed and plentiful praises as our Lord likes and is pleased with.

keyPoints: Al-Waasi' is repeated in many places of the Qur'aan.
It means vast in Attributes and descriptions, such that no one is able to praise Him as He deserves; He is as He praised Himself.
He is vast in might, authority and kingship, vast in grace and perfection, and mighty in generosity and honour.
The Qur'aan clarifies His vast knowledge and mercy (Ghaafir 40:7), vast provision (Noor 24:32) and vast forgiveness (Baqarah 2:268).
From the evidences of this Name is that He made the religion easy and does not burden the servants with more than they can bear (Baqarah 2:286).

evidence.text: Our Lord! You comprehend all things in mercy and knowledge.
Allah burdens not a person beyond his scope.

recall.a: Vast in Attributes and descriptions, such that no one can praise Him as He deserves; He is vast in might, authority and kingship, vast in grace and perfection, mighty in generosity and honour.

recall.q: Which aayah does the author cite for Allaah's vast knowledge and mercy?
recall.a: Ghaafir 40:7: 'Our Lord! You comprehend all things in mercy and knowledge.'

recall.q: Which aayah does the author cite for Allaah's vast forgiveness?
recall.a: Baqarah 2:268: 'Allah promises you Forgiveness from Himself and Bounty...'

recall.q: What is mentioned as one of the evidences of the Name Al-Waasi' in the religion?
recall.a: That He made ease for the servants in their religion and does not burden them beyond what they can bear: 'Allah burdens not a person beyond his scope.' [Baqarah 2:286]
